title: AIPE curated datasheet catalogue (bundled with the package)
redistribution: values transcribed from manufacturer datasheets with locators
notes: 11 materials (incl. 1 synthetic), 6 cores, 4 families, 4 manufacturers; Steinmetz sets fitted to MagNet are 'measurement_fit'.

title: OpenMagnetics / PSMA MAS
redistribution: permitted (Apache-2.0); most values originate from manufacturer datasheets whose own terms are not covered by the MAS licence

raw_unavailable.data/advanced_core_materials.ndjson: Git LFS object sha256 0157ea8b... is no longer served by GitHub for the pinned commit (LFS batch API: 'Object does not exist on the server', checked 2026-11-07); its normalised records and the 81 B-H tables derived from it are preserved, the original file cannot be re-archived

notes: core_materials, core_shapes, cores and the Git-LFS advanced_core_materials file; bobbins, wires and insulation materials are out of scope (winding components). MagNet-origin loss points are flagged duplicates of Princeton MagNet.

title: Princeton MagNet (packaged scalar databases)
redistribution: permitted (MIT; citation of the TPEL papers requested)
notes: All 575,009 rows of the 10 packaged <material>_database.h5 files.

title: Princeton MagNet website B-H waveform downloads (<material>_cycle.zip / _measurements.zip)
redistribution: permitted, but there is no stable URL or checksum (Streamlit per-session downloads)
reason: No pinnable download: the existing user-supplied adapter (PrincetonMagnetAdapter.import_website_zip) converts a manually downloaded zip into v0.2 waveform records with SHA-256; nothing is committed.

title: MagNet Challenge 2023 (MC1) data
reason: The 10-material training link is deleted; validation (256 MB) and testing (1.2 GB, materials A-E) Dropbox bundles carry no licence and are not pinned. The 10 training materials are the MagNet website data (see princeton_magnet_waveforms).

title: MagNet Challenge 2 / MagNetX database
redistribution: not permitted without permission (no LICENSE file; contact pelsmagnet@gmail.com)
reason: No licence; the MagNetX database is a 24.8 GB unlicensed Dropbox archive. The existing read-only adapter (MagnetChallenge2Adapter) imports user-supplied files locally; nothing is downloaded or committed.

title: Paderborn University LEA materialdatabase
redistribution: permitted under GPL-3.0 as a separate copyleft subtree (LICENSE, NOTICE, source offer)
notes: Independent LEA measurements, MagNet-derived permeability (derived_view), TDK MDT exports and digitised datasheet curves are classified separately; the 4 complex_permeability/datasheet files duplicate TDK_MDT and are not imported.

title: Paderborn MagNet-Hub
reason: Model zoo (trained MagNet Challenge models) plus two small test fixtures, not a measurement dataset; the fixture adapter stays available, model inference belongs to AIPE-Magnetics-Design.

title: PSMA / Dartmouth Core Loss Studies (Pilot, Phase II, Phase III)
redistribution: not permitted: reproduction requires written PSMA consent (https://www.psma.com/legal/copyright-statement)
reason: Redistribution prohibited. A user-supplied-file adapter (aipe_magnetics_database.ingest.external.psma_coreloss_db) reads a locally downloaded Phase II coreloss.db into records that stay on the user's machine. Note: 'dPhi' is documented as peak flux [T] but its values are peak flux in Wb (peak B = dPhi / Ae); 'Ecyc' is energy per cycle of the whole core in J.

title: EMPIR 19ENG06 HEFMAG amorphous / nanocrystalline loss and complex permeability
notes: Temperature and DC bias not stated; loss published as J/m^3 per cycle.

title: SMC and Mn-Zn ferrite loss under symmetric / asymmetric triangular polarization
Nabih core characterisation database (Virginia Tech CPES): MHz ferrite loss, permeability, permittivity
notes: MS Access .accdb committed byte-for-byte; read through a reproducible Jackcess TSV export (derived/EXPORT.json). 8 MHz ferrites, sinusoidal P_v(B_m) 0.1-3.5 MHz at 25 degC; the DMR96A permeability is a datasheet curve (classified so). 41 loss points and 1,009 permeability / permittivity rows without a parent ID are excluded.

title: Guillod et al. (Dartmouth, APEC 2024): large-signal dielectric properties of TDK N87
notes: Permittivity and conductivity (small signal, 25/55/85 degC, vs peak electric field) from the MATLAB data.mat files; the repository's N87_mu_small (TDK datasheet) and N87_mu_large (computed from MagNet) are not imported or archived.

title: Composite waveform hypothesis reproducibility dataset (MagNet N87, piecewise-linear excitation)
notes: 42,082 rows with exact five-point waveforms; the R34 variable-temperature set repeats packaged MagNet N87 measurements and is linked to princeton_magnet as a duplicate; raw CSV/MAT/HDF5 (22 MB) retrieved on demand and archived on Hugging Face.

title: INRIM examples of first magnetization curves of ferromagnetic samples
notes: 24 DC first-magnetisation curves (steels, irons, FeSiAl, SMC); the file states no units - stored as A/m and T, flagged.

title: ASU MAPEL MHz core-loss aggregate dataset
reason: No licence. A user-supplied-file adapter (aipe_magnetics_database.ingest.external.asu_mhz_csv) normalises a local copy of MHzCoreLoss.csv (952 rows) and keeps the 13 original study labels as underlying_source so aggregated rows are never counted as independent of the original publications.

title: DTU MHz core loss with DC bias (PC50, PC200), IEEE DataPort 7khj-bd03
redistribution: licence permits it, but the files are behind an IEEE DataPort subscription
reason: Download requires an IEEE account / subscription (~244 MB); access restrictions are not bypassed. Ask the author for an open copy.

title: PFC powder-core B/H waveforms with DC bias (GitHub kingress33)
reason: No licence file; ~2.5 GB of CSV. Ask the owner to add a licence.

title: Pure iron powder cores: permeability and loss vs frequency (Zenodo 12583064)
reason: 48 MB zip not inspected in this cycle (download budget); candidate for the next cycle.

title: INRIM interlaboratory alternating / rotational loss of NO FeSi 3.5 % (Zenodo 14893851)
reason: Electrical-steel loss at 5-200 Hz (mJ/kg); permitted, deferred as low relevance to power-electronics magnetics.

title: HEFMAG example 50 Hz H-J loops of NO / GO FeSi (Zenodo 5910893)
reason: Small example set (2 x 3 loops); deferred, low relevance.

title: Loss of GO / NO steel cores vs frequency at 1 T (Zenodo 16281115)
reason: Electrical steel, DC-505 Hz; deferred, low relevance.

title: Punched M270-35A strips, specific loss at 50 Hz (RODBUK)
reason: Motor-steel data; deferred, low relevance.

title: FEMM material library (B-H curves of steels and magnets)
reason: Aladdin Free Public Licence restricts redistribution; curves of unclear origin.

title: Princeton MagNet raw oscilloscope captures (N87 R34, data processing example)
redistribution: permitted (MIT; cite the MagNet TPEL papers)
notes: 200 unprocessed v(t) / i(t) captures (10,000 samples at 8 ns) at 25 degC (sinusoidal) and 70 degC (triangular, Hdc 15 A/m) with commanded set points, as HDF5 (aipe.magnetics.waveforms/0.2) in waveforms-local/ - on Hugging Face, not in Git.

title: Princeton MagNet tutorial datasets (tutorial/Dataset/Dataset_sine.json, Dataset_tri.json)
reason: Dataset_sine.json (3,495 single-cycle B/H sequences) names no material; Dataset_tri.json (9,754 N87 R22 rows) states no units for Flux_Density / Power_Loss. Not imported rather than guessed; both are processed MagNet data also covered by princeton_magnet.

title: AMPED / University of Pittsburgh / DOE-NETL high-frequency magnetics data
reason: No public tabular dataset with a verifiable licence was found (NETL EDX, OSTI, Zenodo searched); only two datasheet PDFs with unverified terms.

title: TDK / EPCOS public engineering data
reason: Magnetic Design Tool and datasheets may not be redistributed; 74 TDK materials reach the database through MAS.

title: Ferroxcube public engineering data
reason: Steinmetz coefficient spreadsheet and SFDT data are for personal use; 26 materials via MAS.

title: Magnetics Inc. public engineering data
reason: Curve-fit tools are behind a contact form without licence; 88 materials via MAS.

title: Micrometals public engineering data
reason: Curve-fit coefficient workbook carries no licence; 93 materials via MAS.

title: Fair-Rite public engineering data
reason: Per-material complex-permeability CSV files carry no notice; 22 materials via MAS. Good candidate for a permission request.

title: VAC (Vacuumschmelze) public engineering data
reason: PDF datasheets only; 2 materials via MAS.

title: Metglas / Proterial public engineering data
reason: PDF datasheets only.

title: TDG public engineering data
reason: PDF sheets only; 118 materials via MAS.

title: DMEGC public engineering data
reason: PDF sheets only (note: dmegc.com is not the manufacturer); 47 materials via MAS.

title: Samwha public engineering data
reason: PDF catalogues only; 4 materials via MAS.

title: Coilcraft public engineering data
reason: S-parameter / SPICE models of components, not material data.

title: Wurth Elektronik public engineering data
redistribution: not permitted (non-sublicensable model licence; data mining banned)
reason: REDEXPERT / simulation libraries may not be redistributed; 12 materials via MAS.
